name: production-canvas-desktop
description: Frame-linked annotations and visual context for native Codex collaboration on video.
author: Justin Yao

scripts.pack:win: node -e "const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process'); const git = (...args) => execFileSync('git', args, { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); if (git('status', '--porcelain')) throw Error('Commit source changes before packing'); const commit = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'); execFileSync(process.execPath, [require.resolve('electron-builder/cli.js'), '--win', 'portable', '--x64', '--publish', 'never', '--config.extraMetadata.buildCommit=' + commit], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.check: node --check app/main.js && node --check app/canvas.js && node --check app/project.js && node --check app/public/canvas-ui.js && node --check app/public/review-timeline.js && node --check app/public/note-location.js && node --check scripts/build-demo.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-opening.cjs && node --check app/tauri-host.cjs && node --check scripts/stage-tauri.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-tauri.cjs && node --check app/comfy-inspection.js && node --check app/desktop-support.js && node --check scripts/verify-tauri-integrations.cjs && npm test
scripts.prepack:win: npm run check && npm run verify:sample && npm run verify:opening
